programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner
programme.desc: With the midterm elections only two weeks away, a lot of Democrats are feeling giddy about the prospects of flipping both houses of Congress. This week, Alex breaks down why overconfidence can be a risk, and why this will be a state by state, issue by issue battle until the end. She’s joined by Alex Seitz-Wald, Deputy Editor of the Midcoast Villager, who gives a local perspective on why the Senate race in Maine is still anyone’s call. Then Crooked media’s Nate Silver, author of the Silver Bulletin and co-host of Still Counting, joins to break down the latest polling and how it compares with elections past.

programme.title: Hysteria
programme.desc: Jane Coaston joins Erin Ryan to break down Vivek Ramaswamy’s vile attack ad in the Ohio governor’s race, Bari Weiss’s predictable push to smear Abdul El-Sayed, and ICE ramping up its daily arrests ahead of Election Day. Then they review the most important down-ballot abortion measures in Idaho, Missouri, Virginia, and Nevada. They wrap up with a petty rant session about Trump’s women’s health initiative.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: Gas prices go up, Ukraine’s Starlink goes down, and Ilhan Omar is caught in the middle. This week, Ben Feldman of Ghosts and Superstore talks Netflix fame, the French-Canadian language police, and being a dirty little trailer pig (?), while Dusty Slay opens up about drag queens, ghost writers and private drawings. We shake our fist at costume parties, tiny plates and visiting L.A. for The Rant Wheel, and take our time saying farewell with Second Thoughts.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: This weekend, Senator Bernie Sanders will rally with Florida Democratic State Representative Angie Nixon, who is challenging Republican Senator Ashley Moody for Florida's U.S. Senate seat. Running on a platform of lowering costs, raising wages, and putting everyday people first, Nixon joins Jane to discuss her campaign.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: JD Vance paints Trump as a saint, while Vivek Ramaswamy goes as low as humanly possible to save his flailing campaign in Ohio. This week, LA mayoral candidate Nithya Raman joins to talk about her race against Mayor Karen Bass, and the alluring myths and legends of Los Angeles. Then Brennan Lee Mulligan aligns himself with the nerds and bards of Dungeons & Dragons. The Rant Wheel has us spinning about mosquitos, putting people on the spot, and wedding speeches. And our Second Thoughts are second to none

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: In American politics, candidates often say they care about kitchen-table issues and working-class voters. Yet, if you look at both parties' candidates, you'll find they are more alike than you think: the same five universities and four careers. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in "Angel Trap" on "Charlie's Angels." Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an "accidental" meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Jill and Kelly con a compulsive gambler out of his money in order to trap him in his usual burglary method of replenishing his gambling stakes in "The Big Tap Out," on "Charlie's Angels."

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sinister forces attempt to discredit the spokesman for free Poland in "Angels on a String," on "Charlie's Angels." An international political leader is abducted and a double substituted for him at a world conference being held at a resort where Charlie's Angels are vacationing. Having met the leader earlier, Sabrina knows something is wrong. Soon, the girls discover that the culprits plan to have their importer deliver a false, radicalized, seemingly irrational keynote address. Naturally, the press would misquote him, fatally damaging the cause. Sabrina, disguised as the hotel waitress assigned to serve the imposter, saves the life of our Assistant Secretary to State by switching away a poisoned wineglass. Dressed as a maid, Jill infiltrates the ranks of the phony FBI designated to protect him. Together the girls rescue the real politico in time for his all-important address. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: I Tested The Strangest Ways People Have Died
programme.desc: I tested some of the strangest and most unexpected ways people have actually died, recreating different scenarios to see just how real the danger is.

programme.title: I Tested Home Alone Booby Traps
programme.desc: I tested real booby traps inspired by classic movies, engineering and building them myself with my friends to see how dangerous they'd actually be in real life.

programme.title: I Tested "Unbreakable" Products
programme.desc: I put products that claim to be "unbreakable" through extreme tests to see if they can really live up to that promise or if they'll shatter under pressure.

programme.title: 10 Things You Didn't Know Could Kill You
programme.desc: I tested ten surprising things you didn't know could actually kill you, breaking down some common myths to see which ones hold up in real life.

programme.title: I Played GTA With Real Pain
programme.desc: I played GTA 5, Skyrim, Fortnite, and The Forest while wearing a haptic suit that delivers real pain, and the amount of pain it caused genuinely shocked me.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Weapons From Temu
programme.desc: I bought, unboxed, and tested banned weapons from Temu using ballistic dummies with my friends to see just how dangerous they actually are.

programme.title: I Tested Ai Dogs vs Real Dogs
programme.desc: I bought a real AI robot dog and took it to the dog park to see if it could actually hold its own against real dogs and even replace mine.

programme.title: I Tested 5000 Years of Armor
programme.desc: I tested 5000 years of armor throughout history to see how well it actually holds up against real weapons and attacks.

programme.title: 10 Things You Didn't Know Could Kill You (finale)
programme.desc: I tested 10 more ways you didn't know you could die, including myths like a gate closing on you, a camping tent catching fire, a chandelier falling on you, and a heavy machinery accident.

programme.title: I Tested $5000 Life Rafts
programme.desc: I inflated emergency life rafts in interesting places, like a snow covered mountain and inside a compact car.

programme.title: Overnight on the Worlds Cheapest Aircraft Carrier
programme.desc: I brought my friends to one of the most historic aircraft carriers in the world.

programme.title: I Survived In A Glass House
programme.desc: Tyler spends 24 hours living in a glass-walled structure mounted on a truck while driving through a busy city. They systematically remove levels of privacy, exposing themselves to the public while interacting with strangers and facing psychological challenges.

programme.title: Can You ACTUALLY Be Hypnotized??
programme.desc: I hope you all enjoyed this journey through the world of hypnotism. A huge shout out to our hypnotist Zach Pincince. The video includes behind-the-scenes content and features our stunt coordinator Jared Andrew Hughes. Shoutout to everyone who helped with the project.

programme.title: Why This Submarine Is Only $500
programme.desc: I stayed on a military submarine. Check out Why This Aircraft Carrier Costs $1500. It's real creepy.

programme.title: I Tried Escaping Impossible Deaths
programme.desc: I put myself into different deadly situations to see if I could escape in time, like a house fire, quicksand, being locked in a freezer, a straitjacket, a car trunk, and even the back of a police car.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Island Survival Myths
programme.desc: I tested popular island survival myths to see which ones would actually help you survive and which ones would get you killed.

programme.title: I Tested Movie Deaths In Real Life (again)
programme.desc: I tested movie deaths from popular films in real life again, including a real-life tree cutting scene, to see how accurate they actually are.

programme.title: 10 Sports You Didn't Know Could Kill You (again)
programme.desc: I teamed up with athletes again to showcase dangerous sports impacts and just how much damage they can actually cause.

programme.title: I Tested Brutal Movie Deaths
programme.desc: I tested some of the most brutal movie deaths in real life, including getting hit in the face with a flare, getting stuck in a trash compactor, and having a piano fall on top of me.

programme.title: I Confronted Mack
programme.desc: I finally sat down and asked Mack the questions you guys have been wondering, like what happened to him and whether he'll ever be in another MrBeast video again.

programme.title: I Tested 10,000 Years of Weapons
programme.desc: I tested weapons ranging from 1,000,000 BC all the way to modern artillery, including a tank-destroying cannon, to see if ancient and advanced weapons are truly effective in real scenarios.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Kids Toys
programme.desc: I tested popular kids toys to see if they're actually as dangerous as everyone says they are.

programme.title: 10 Sports You Didn't Know Could Kill You
programme.desc: I teamed up with real athletes to recreate sports impacts on ballistic dummies, testing how dangerous common injuries can be and revealing just how much damage they really cause.

programme.title: I Scientifically Proved Ghosts Are Real (ft. Airrack)
programme.desc: I set up an experiment with Airrack at the historic Bracken Fern Manor to figure out once and for all whether or not ghosts are actually real.

programme.title: I Tested 1000 Years of Punishments
programme.desc: I tested 1000 years of punishments including the guillotine, the garrote, stoning, and the spiked barrel.

programme.title: I Took a Scientist Ghost Hunting
programme.desc: I took real scientists out to a haunted location to see if they could scientifically explain or debunk what happens there.

programme.title: Hidden Cameras You've Walked Past
